title: 2026 Season Power Rankings
subtitle: Post–Week 1 board — juice the studs, junk the holes (and the lineup sins). Whole picture, not just points for.
method: W/L + win quality + roster ceiling + FAAB + pedigree + sit/start; PF is evidence, not the ranking.

rankings.blurb: Juice: Week 1 wasn’t a win so much as a format war crime — Allen 45 / Watson 44 / Jeanty 41 / Baun 35 into a 315 kitty that made 250 look like a participation trophy. Four studs on one card is how you own the board before MNF even matters. The cheat-code QB is still cheating. Junk: FAAB already down to $51 after shopping like Black Friday; one injury and the cart’s empty. Prove it was a floor, not a ceiling — and don’t spend the rest of the season living off Week 1 highlights.

Juice: Rookie chair, first Wheels Up win, Monday heist — Walker’s 48 flipped a funeral into 259.5 and stole Gavin’s tweet before the win tweet even posted. Dart’s in the building for $16 and the new franchise just cashed its first column. Junk: Still a prove-it roster with IR collecting names; one week doesn’t make you contenders, it makes you dangerous. Survive Saltese next and we’ll talk about legitimacy.

Juice: 258.5 over the dual-era champ and a full $115 FAAB wallet — Lamar / JJ / Achane / Kelce finally looked like the magazine cover, not the floor team. Swift stack did adult work and Monday made the card honest. Junk: Depth still thin behind the stars; if the names don’t smash, there’s no Plan B on the bench. Enjoy the bounce while Kyle’s résumé digests — Substation’s ‘ugly W’ is next and won’t pad your ego.

Juice: Beat Bill 255–241 and Gesicki’s 23 did the dirty work against a ‘premium’ TE room — that’s how you start 1-0 with a smirk. JSN punched in; the offense is real; the flex/TE call that week was the difference. Junk: Micah still on IR, FAAB at $83, and Hyper’s Monday vibes are coming to town. Don’t get cute with the lineup when the board’s already proven Gesicki can cook.

Juice: Watt’s half-century and Henry’s 43 turned a knife fight into 254 — veteran violence still scores, and Vele’s a nice add. That’s how you bury a talented Newman card without needing every starter to cook. Junk: Kamara/Jacobs already on IR, FAAB tightening, and next up is Bill looking for revenge. Pedigree alone doesn’t tackle — keep starting the killers and stop trusting the injured names to heal on schedule.

Juice: Clean 246 over the Host and a core that actually showed up — Puka / Kyren / Roquan / Hutch is a plan, not a prayer. You didn’t need a miracle; you needed the studs in the lineup and they showed. Junk: WR dies after Evans, TE isn’t a smash, and Ultron’s Chase-with-a-chip is waiting with the richest FAAB left. Stay boring; boring wins weeks. One cute flex and you’re the next Host story.

Juice: 241 as a losing score is still a flex in most rooms; Warner / Lake / Warren remain filthy and Wingard + Dorian Williams upgraded the IDP glue. The ceiling that sat at #1 preseason didn’t vanish overnight. Junk: The lineup tax is the story — Pitts’ zero in the flex while Gesicki dropped 23, Bowers still on ice, and a ‘premium’ TE room that lost the position battle 23–12 combined. Drop from 1 is earned when you gift Luke a free win on sit/start. Climb starts by ending the experimental flex.

Juice: Bijan and Olave at 34 each into 246.5 is a perfectly respectable card — you just lost a game you already tweeted. Ezeiruaku’s in; the skill core can still print. Junk: Monday erasure tastes like vinegar, Donald’s on IR, and Week 2 is TTAB’s nuclear reactor. Survival mode with teeth — don’t celebrate early and don’t leave points in the wrong slot when 246.5 already tastes like an L.

Juice: CMC / Nico / Rice / Dak is still a championship spine, and $109 FAAB means Kyle can buy a fix. Dual-era champ résumé doesn’t expire in seven days just because Divers looked like the cover. Junk: The lineup sin was Burns’ 4 on DL — a four-point apology from a ‘safe’ edge while Divers closed 258.5. 237 is ugly-adjacent for this franchise. Don’t panic-trade the spine; do panic about starting empty IDP.

Juice: CeeDee + McBride is still disgusting, Trotter just led the league in IDP, and $111 FAAB can paper over sins. Talent’s there; Week 1 was a self-inflicted wound, not a talent problem. Junk: Started Waddle for 1 in the flex — one point from a featured WR while the Host card needed every scrap. That’s the sit/start that turned a manageable week into 216.5 and a freefall from #2. Hosting duties didn’t include receiving yards.

Juice: Hurts + JT + a WR orchard should not live this low on talent alone — 221 with Flowers cooking means the ceiling’s still awake. The names are playoff-caliber when they remember the assignment. Junk: Brown and Adams combined for 10 as starters while Watt alone outscored both — that’s two WR1s totaling a mediocre TE game on a losing card. Sleepwalking ends or the demons stay 14-adjacent. Start the alphas like you drafted them for a reason.

Juice: Got the W over Ultron when the garage sale opened — Saquon still buttons, LaPorta/Goedert TE premium is real. A win is a win when Aga’s top shelf rings hollow. Junk: 193 is a ‘win’ that looks like a loss on the PF board; Nix started for 5 in new colors; poorest FAAB at $70. Bank the column, then fix the card — Divers are next and won’t gift you empty Chase weeks.

Juice: Richest FAAB left ($126) and Ja’Marr Chase still exists when he remembers how to play football; Hooker $18 is a real IDP bandage. Caleb’s 41 tried to drag bricks across the finish line. Junk: The lineup tape is the roast — Chase 3 / Cook 10 / Loveland 0 / Garrett 0 as starters. Top-shelf draft capital totaling 13 from the headliners while Sub scraped 193 for the W. Week 1 put the receipt on the fridge.

Juice: Gibbs’ 42 was a lighthouse; Crosby/Simmons DL can still ruin weeks; $98 FAAB isn’t dead. One lighthouse doesn’t keep you on the bus, but it proves the ceiling still flashes. Junk: Survivor Week 1 eviction after London 4 / Pickens 5 / Fannin 5 into 176.5 against a 315 hate crime. That’s three skill starters totaling 14 while TTAB’s nuclear four printed alone. Off the bus. Climb starts with the skill guys remembering their jobs — and you starting whoever actually shows up.
